question: A circular track's inner and outer radii are 25 m and 28 m respectively. The cost (in ₹) of levelling the track at ₹28 per m² is: [Use π = 22/7]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Cost = Area of Track × Rate per m²

Total Cost = π(R² − r²) × Rate

Total Cost = (22/7) × (28² − 25²) × 28

Total Cost = 22 × (28 − 25) × (28 + 25) × 4

Total Cost = 22 × 3 × 53 × 4 = 13992

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13,992.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Outer radius (R) = 28 m

Inner radius (r) = 25 m

Rate of levelling = ₹28 per m²

**Formula Used:**

Area of circular track = π(R² − r²)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92ef3b348fdf77e39ab4f01433427d41fa84fcf6e8f8d5f688431c7c8b11cf1d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = (22/7) × (28² − 25²)

⇒ Area = (22/7) × (28 − 25) × (28 + 25)

⇒ Area = (22/7) × 3 × 53

⇒ Area = 3498/7 m²

⇒ Total Cost = Area × Rate

⇒ Total Cost = (3498/7) × 28

⇒ Total Cost = 3498 × 4

⇒ Total Cost = 13992

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13,992.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Circular Ring

The region bounded by two concentric circles is called a circular ring or track. Area = π(R² − r²) = π(R − r)(R + r).

Difference Between Fencing and Levelling

Fencing relates to the boundary, so Cost of Fencing = Perimeter × Rate per unit length. Levelling refers to making the surface flat, so Cost of Levelling = Area × Rate per unit area.

Perimeter of a Semicircle

The total perimeter includes the curved arc and the straight diameter. Perimeter = πr + 2r = r(π + 2).
